translation: Bitter in flavor, slightly warm. It treats cough with rebellion (咳逆), evil qi of the five viscera (五臟邪氣), regulates the center, boosts qi (益氣), brightens the eyes, and kills lice. The green talisman (青符), white talisman (白符), red talisman (赤符), dark talisman (玄符), and yellow talisman (黃符) each supplement its corresponding viscus according to its color.
